{{Quote|Tickets for the exciting, pulse-pounding Boonta Eve Race sold here!|The ticket vendor|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]</ref>}}
This '''ticket vendor''', a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]], sold tickets to the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] during the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].

During selling tickets, the Ticket Vendor wore a Beige all-covering cloak and a visor-like headpiece.
